exposure: Single intrauterine fetal death (sIUFD) in monochorionic twin pregnancies
cohort: 81 monochorionic twin pregnancies with sIUFD after 14 weeks gestation
finding: Monochorionic twin pregnancies with sIUFD are associated with high rates of perinatal mortality, preterm birth, and neurological abnormalities in surviving co-twins, emphasizing the need for specialized care and further research.
mod_finding: Preterm birth (<37 weeks gestation) was the commonest adverse outcome (77%): half were spontaneous and half iatrogenic.
